pages.text: Press $(bold)R$() to toggle Battle Mode. In Battle Mode your attacks become directional combos and you gain access to dodge.$(br2)$(bold)Dodge:$() Hold Sneak + movement direction. Costs stamina. The stamina bar appears bottom-left of your screen.

$(bold)Stamina is shared with ParCool.$() Wall-runs, vaults, and parkour moves drain the same bar as dodging. Manage it — running out mid-fight means no dodges.$(br2)$(bold)Combos:$() Hold attack to chain hits. Each weapon type has different combo patterns. Experiment.

$(bold)Skill Tree:$() Find Skill Books in loot. Basic skills spawn in Ruined Portals; advanced skills come from dungeons and cities.$(br2)The skill tree has 9 categories. Pick a direction early — trying to spread points thin doesn't work well. Warrior, Berserker, and Rogue are strong starting paths.
